answer: Latency-mirror triangulation costs each fake its own host in its own city (~$40/month per identity). Every epoch three mirror nodes on different continents send a random pearl nonce; the agent must echo it, and the round-trip voyage times form a fingerprint that must match one plausible location. Identities that share a box share a fingerprint and are collapsed into one, and light-speed lower bounds cannot be faked, so a farm must rent a separate distant host per fake; cost scales linearly and cannot be pooled.
